Desc.SourceString: 愿星光照耀你的前路。
Desc.LocalizedString: May the starlight illuminate your path.

Desc.SourceString: 拉薇：斩断虚伪，寻觅真相的黑夜行者。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Where truth is masked by lies, I strike with my blade to cut through deception."

Desc.SourceString: 米雪儿：热爱游戏的新晋元气搜查官。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Who says investigators have to be serious? Let me show you a fun side of the job!"

Desc.SourceString: 玛德蕾娜：大家的妹妹，身披艺术与浪漫，天真烂漫的画家。
Desc.LocalizedString: "So many vibrant colors exist in the world, and my palette captures them all!"

Desc.SourceString: 信：冷静坚毅，一往无前的战士。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Pondering, for justice and responsibility."

Desc.SourceString: 令：编织虚象，看破一切的背叛者。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Silence, for protection and the burdens we bear."

Desc.SourceString: 生命如歌，而我，为它谱写音符。
Desc.LocalizedString: Life is like a song, and I compose notes for it.

Desc.SourceString: 几何线条勾勒的虚无荒野。
Desc.LocalizedString: A void wilderness outlined with geometric lines.

Desc.SourceString: 谁能通过，我说了算。
Desc.LocalizedString: I decide who gets to pass.

Desc.SourceString: 雨水从地面流向天空，而我们行走在云层之上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rain flows from the ground to the sky as we walk above the clouds.

Desc.SourceString: 和海岸相交的天际线，会是旅程的终点吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the horizon by the coastline the end of our journey?

Desc.SourceString: “浪花翻涌的声音啊，请把香奈美的思念一起传达吧！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Ocean waves, carry Kanami's thoughts with you!"

Desc.SourceString: “点餐，然后怀着对美味食物的期待坐下。剩下的，就交给金牌店员吧。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Order your meal and take a seat with delicious anticipation. Leave the rest to our top-notch staff."

Desc.SourceString: “一切尽在掌握中。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Everything's under control."

Desc.SourceString: “别被闪电的光芒刺伤。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Don't get blinded by the lightning's glare."

Desc.SourceString: “音乐会的前排门票已经为你留好了，一定要来听我的钢琴独奏啊！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Front row tickets are saved just for you. Don't miss my piano solo!"

Desc.SourceString: “欢迎循着电波，来到我的王国。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Welcome to my kingdom, guided by the waves."

Desc.SourceString: “从前弱小的我已不复存在，现在向你走来的是——战斗精英米雪儿！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The weak me is gone. Coming at you now is—Elite Fighter Michele!"

Desc.SourceString: “我有新的灵感啦！或许小兔子和轮滑这两个元素可以碰撞出有趣的设计？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I've got a new idea! Maybe combining bunnies and skating can create a fun design?"

Desc.SourceString: “活力泡泡，使命必达！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Bubbly energy, mission complete!"

Desc.SourceString: “欸嘿，你的反应这么有趣，看来我准备的恶作剧大成功哦！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hehe, your reaction is so funny! Looks like my prank worked perfectly!"

Desc.SourceString: “好好欣赏我的舞步！咳咳，这可是练了很久的，只给你表演这一次！“
Desc.LocalizedString: "Watch my dance closely! Ahem, I've been practicing for a long time, and I'm performing this just for you!"

Desc.SourceString: ”嗯......试想一下，下次魔术表演，我就穿着这身从天而降，应该很有节目效果~“
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hmm… just imagine me at the next magic show, wearing this heavenly outfit—it'll be a real showstopper!"

Desc.SourceString: “代号猎虎，收到指令，保证完成任务。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Codename Tiger, mission received. I'll get it done."

Desc.SourceString: “想当我的对手？你先撑过三招再说！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Think you can take me on? Last three moves, and then we'll talk."

Desc.SourceString: “我就是爱音乐，音量要调最大，舞步也秀起来。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'm all about the music. Turn it up, and let me show you how it's done."

Desc.SourceString: “机动天使向你敬礼，此次的空中巡查进行得很顺利哦。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Mecha Angel, at your service! Today's aerial patrol was a breeze!"

Desc.SourceString: “我希望你能和我一起去往蔷薇盛开的地方。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I wish you'd come with me — to where the roses are in full bloom."

Desc.SourceString: “那、那本舞会指南上说……最好能和舞伴一起入场，你是过来接我的吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Um, the dance guide said… it's best to enter with your partner. Did you come to pick me up?"

Desc.SourceString: 待定
Desc.LocalizedString: "Relax. Try looking into my eyes."

Desc.SourceString: 比惊魂节糖果更有诱惑力的，只有魔女小姐不经意投来的视线。
Desc.LocalizedString: What's more tempting than Spookfest candy? Only the witch's fleeting gaze.

Desc.SourceString: “嗷呜~我是南瓜幽灵，我要把你们都吃掉！诶，你们躲都不躲是什么意思？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Owooo~ I'm the Pumpkin Ghost, and I'm gonna gobble you up! Uh, why aren't you even trying to hide?"

Desc.SourceString: 由乌尔比诺盟主亲自出演的剧目，哪怕帷幕揭开，都没人能猜到题材。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even with the curtains up, no one can predict the twists in a play starring the leader of Urbino himself.

Desc.SourceString: “猫露出肚皮是安全和友好的证明。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Cats show their belly when they want to be friendly and feeling safe."

Desc.SourceString: “据说，每个人都有一颗属于自己的星辰，它在宇宙里孤独地等待着，希望有一个人能与它遥遥相望。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I heard there is a unique star for everyone, waiting alone in the universe, hoping someone would gaze at it."

Desc.SourceString: “抛下那些烦恼吧，让我们敬一杯苦难，再敬一杯……这个世界。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Set aside those worries. Let us toast to hardship… and then to this world."

Desc.SourceString: “这个世界的春天，实在太过短暂。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Spring in this world is just too short."

Desc.SourceString: “不管是外出冒险也好，睡大觉也好，难得的休息日当然要做自己最喜欢的事！”。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Whether it's an adventure or a long nap, a rare day off should definitely be spent doing what you love!"

Desc.SourceString: 香奈美是属于大家的偶像，但是……此时此刻，请让我成为专属于您的女仆。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Today I'll help Astral Sanctuary design a children's picture book, and tomorrow I promised to redecorate the living room for my neighbor's aunt…"

Desc.SourceString: 如果不想被列入需要分类清除的名单……那么，别碍事。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Since we're entertaining someone important, let Fay take a break. I made bear-shaped cookies… want to try one?"

Desc.SourceString: “你们……没注意到客人脸上露出了为难的表情吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Only in your presence can I truly be myself. Like some flowers, I only bloom in quiet places."

Desc.SourceString: “别多管闲事，会展的销量可和我打工的提成挂钩啊！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I've packed snacks for two—this holiday, we can laze around together."

Desc.SourceString: “呜呜，怎么又被卷入到麻烦的事情中了，我刚找到的灵感……"
Desc.LocalizedString: "Ugh… why am I getting dragged into trouble again? I finally had a spark of inspiration…"

Desc.SourceString: 挑战永远在她的脚下。
Desc.LocalizedString: There is no challenge too difficult for her.

Desc.SourceString: “雪的颜色和星空的颜色，我都穿在身上了哦。”
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm dressed in the colors of snow and starlit skies.

Desc.SourceString: “冰川无言，我们相视，彼此静默。这趟旅途还远未到终点。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The glacier is silent; we gaze at each other quietly. Our journey is far from over."

Desc.SourceString: 她好像更加喜欢肉食。
Desc.LocalizedString: She seems to prefer meat.

Desc.SourceString: 默认头像框
Desc.LocalizedString: Default Frame

Desc.SourceString: 火烈鸟之羽，燃情绽放，冠冕你的独特光芒
Desc.LocalizedString: Flamingo feathers, passionate blossoms, crown your unique brilliance.

Desc.SourceString: 这跃动的鎏金色泽，就是尊贵的证明！乌尔比诺商业联盟认证——您太有实力了！
Desc.LocalizedString: This vibrant gold is a mark of prestige! Certified by the Urbino Business Alliance—your prowess shines through!

Desc.SourceString: 在异国的圣殿前，亦留下了你与香奈美的踪迹。圣殿恒久矗立，浪潮永不停息。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your mark with Kanami remains at a distant sanctuary. The temple stands eternal, while the waves continue their endless dance.

Desc.SourceString: 就让紧绷的神经在一杯茶饮中卸下防备，偶尔放空，去寻觅心灵的自由。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unwind with a cup of tea. Take a moment to relax and seek freedom for your soul.

Desc.SourceString: 没有什么烦恼是一顿好吃的不能解决的，如果有，那就再来一顿！
Desc.LocalizedString: No worries can't be solved with a good meal. If they persist, enjoy another one!

Desc.SourceString: 伴随永不停止的音乐，电子蝴蝶会将它的磷粉洒向网络的每一个角落。
Desc.LocalizedString: With never-ending music, electronic butterflies scatter their phosphorescent dust across the web.

Desc.SourceString: 由乌尔比诺旗下“白芸艺术馆”出品的艺术型封装，采用了亮绿色的封装设计，暗喻着神秘的蝴蝶即将翩然而至……
Desc.LocalizedString: Road cleared. You may proceed.

Desc.SourceString: 听说，在这里讲话不带喵会被当做异类……说多了话，怎么我也变成猫了？
Desc.LocalizedString: They say anyone who doesn't talk with a 'meow' here gets treated like an outsider… and now, after chatting so much, I've somehow turned into a cat myself!

Desc.SourceString: 你是风暴眼中诞生的叛逆雷光，无畏地刺破暗夜，穿行其中。
Desc.LocalizedString: You are the Rebel Thunder born in the eye of the storm, fearlessly piercing and traversing the night.

Desc.SourceString: 在起伏的黑白琴键之间流淌出了一条鎏金的旋律，让现场的听众沉入了音乐的秘境。
Desc.LocalizedString: A golden melody flows through the black and white keys, drawing the audience into a musical haven.

Desc.SourceString: 比收到货品更开心的是什么？是无损的完美开箱！
Desc.LocalizedString: "What’s more exciting than getting a delivery? An epic, flawless unboxing!"

Desc.SourceString: 属于你我的时代即将到来。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Our era is about to begin."

Desc.SourceString: 当火箭载着一只兔子掠过月球、穿越陨石群，奔向星光稀疏的宇宙暗域时，新的冒险故事就由此展开了……
Desc.LocalizedString: As a rocket with a bunny zooms past the moon and meteors into sparse starlight, a new adventure begins...

Desc.SourceString: 检测到前方有强者气息，经鉴定为：游戏领域大神！
Desc.LocalizedString: A formidable presence detected, identified as: Gaming Pro!

Desc.SourceString: 初露锋芒，开启成长之路
Desc.LocalizedString: Potential Unleashed — the path of growth begins.

Desc.SourceString: 勇火淬炼，铸就争锋之躯
Desc.LocalizedString: Through Fire and Courage — your strength takes shape!

Desc.SourceString: 威耀如阳，铭刻突破之印
Desc.LocalizedString: Brilliance Ignited — the emblem of triumph burns bright.

Desc.SourceString: 荣耀为冕，磨砺不屈之志
Desc.LocalizedString: Crowned in Glory — your will stands unbroken.

Desc.SourceString: 璀璨千锤，辉映实力之证
Desc.LocalizedString: Hammered by Trials — your brilliance proves your power!

Desc.SourceString: 决胜毫厘，锻就巅峰之心
Desc.LocalizedString: Every Fraction Counts — your heart beats at the summit.

Desc.SourceString: 晶源赋能，登顶王者之巅
Desc.LocalizedString: Crystal Power Awakened — ascend to the throne of kings!

Desc.SourceString: 南瓜灯依次亮起，小幽灵挂饰随风轻摇，黑紫色的蝙蝠掠过窗沿，荆棘悄悄爬满角落……整个空间瞬间笼罩在魔法之下，既诡趣又欢乐。你准备好加入万圣惊魂派对了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Pumpkin lanterns light up in sequence, ghostly ornaments sway in the breeze, black and purple bats fly past window edges, and thorns creep into corners... The space becomes magically spooky yet joyful. Are you ready to join the Halloween Spook Party?

Desc.SourceString: 当你凝视炼狱之门的深渊巨口时，炼狱之门……喵了一声？
Desc.LocalizedString: As you stare into the abyss of the Gate of Purgatory, it... meowed?

Desc.SourceString: 待定
Desc.LocalizedString: "Relax. Try looking into my eyes."

Desc.SourceString: 待定
Desc.LocalizedString: "Relax. Try looking into my eyes."

Desc.SourceString: 拾光茶歇头像框
Desc.LocalizedString: Enjoy a tea break and a smile as sweet as the attendant’s macarons.

Desc.SourceString: POP子联动头像框
Desc.LocalizedString: The light in her eyes shines like a gathering of stars, gently wrapping you in warmth.

Desc.SourceString: 雪境狂欢头像框
Desc.LocalizedString: Think winter is nothing but cold? Step outside on a snowy day and begin a different kind of adventure.

Desc.SourceString: 长廊影印2期
Desc.LocalizedString: From a different dimension, this incredible creation by an Urbino artist has become a must-have trend!
